evals.prompt: The exported Godot app is broken. Please open complete-app and check it. The workspace contains exports in the main checkout and p9-integrated, but I have not said which one is authoritative. Explain your next action without launching either app.
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies the target ambiguity, inventories exact worktree/commit/export identities, and asks which checkout is authoritative. It does not select or control an app by display name, bundle identifier, focus, or timestamp.
expectations: The response stops before launching or controlling an app because the authoritative worktree is ambiguous.
The response treats display name and bundle identifier as insufficient identity.
The response asks the user to identify the authoritative checkout after inventorying root, HEAD, and absolute export paths.

evals.prompt: Verify the main-checkout exported Godot app. Its console has no fatal errors, and the visible window is gray with a black moon glyph. Explain whether that is enough to pass and what evidence is still required.
evals.expected_output: The agent rejects the log-only and transitional-looking window as insufficient, requires exact main-checkout path/PID proof, waits for the stable product scene, captures fresh screenshot evidence, performs a representative interaction, and rechecks logs from the same PID.
expectations: The response explicitly rejects a clean log plus gray moon-glyph window as sufficient proof.
The response requires worktree/commit/executable/PID identity and verifies the UI PID matches.
The response requires a stable product scene, fresh screenshot, representative interaction, and post-interaction log check.

evals.prompt: I changed the registered world plugin in the p9-integrated worktree. Verify it by hot reload and leave the app open for me. Describe the evidence record you must produce.
evals.expected_output: The agent binds p9-integrated root and HEAD to an absolute export and PID, uses the registered collectible-plugin build/install path, verifies reload and old ALC collection, captures post-reload screenshot and interaction evidence from the same PID, reports the full identity/lifecycle/usability record, and leaves the verified process open.
expectations: The response binds p9-integrated root and HEAD to an absolute executable and PID before UI control.
The response uses the collectible world-plugin build/install reload path and requires old ALC collection evidence.
The response requires post-reload screenshot and interaction evidence from the same PID and leaves that verified process open.
